contracts: Plant accepts only finite bounded actuation and exposes PlantState.
Raycaster returns nearest range only; target identity is not observable.
Blind sectors produce invalid max-range samples, never synthetic free space.
Sensor noise uses an independent deterministic seed.
Scenario manifests reject physical-authority claims and require unknown_is_blocking.
Trace digest is canonical and byte-stable for equal event sequences.
negative_cases: nearest static target wins over farther dynamic target
parallel and behind geometry produce no false hit
blind sector is invalid rather than free
observation contains no target identity or truth pose
invalid dt and over-limit commands are rejected
invalid observation shapes and negative ranges are rejected
limitations: No MVSim sensor-model or ROS transport acceptance is claimed.
No physical robot, Livox calibration, motor dynamics or competition authority is claimed.
Static collision checking against wall geometry remains a referee/planning concern; the plant is intentionally not a hidden collision oracle.
The current trace records observations and commands; map/topology/path version fields must be attached by later P3.5 orchestration.
